description: Groups of URLs competing for the same search queries: shared queries, intent and content similarity, the primary page, the recommended action and a confidence score. Separates harmful cannibalization from legitimate multiple rankings. Uses your connected Google Search Console (read-only) plus a crawl of the site; the analysis is reused for a day. Never changes your site: redirects are proposals only. Needs an API key from a paid plan.
